purpose: Re-run the macrocycle docking campaign against an experimental Streptococcus mutans GtfB structure instead of the GtfC structure 3AIC.

receptor.bound_inhibitor: acarbose, deposited as two GLC moieties plus one AC1 moiety

source_publication.authors: Schormann N, Patel M, Thannickal L, Purushotham S, Wu R, Mieher JL, Wu H, Deivanayagam C
source_publication.journal: Acta Crystallogr F Struct Biol Commun 79(Pt 5):119-127

receptor.why_this_one_and_not_the_others: 8FJ9 is the same crystal form and resolution but apo, so it gives no native ligand for a redocking calibration control. 8FK4 is the acarbose co-crystal in which the inhibitor fits the density better, but it is 3.25 A with eight copies in the asymmetric unit. 8FKL is the highest resolution at 1.48 A but it was truncated by proteolysis and is missing domains B and IV, which flank the active-site cleft, so it is the wrong model for docking. 8FJC is the only deposited structure that is GtfB, intact, inhibitor-bound, and better than 3 A.

catalytic_residues_gtfb_numbering.provenance: Residue correspondence and the acarbose hydrogen-bond table are taken from Schormann et al. 2023 (DOI 10.1107/S2053230X23003199), Table 4 and Section 3.2. Not inferred by alignment here.

wide_28.rationale: Identical to the box edge used in the existing campaign on 3AIC, so the new numbers are directly comparable with the old ones. It is also, measured rather than assumed, close to the smallest cube these ligands fit in: over all 972 committed single-model conformers the largest heavy-atom diameter is 27.31 A, so a 28 A cube leaves about 0.34 A per side at the most extended conformer on record. None of the 972 would fail a 28 A edge and 17 of them would fail a 26 A one. The box may still be large relative to the binding cleft, which is a separate and untested concern.

tight_auto.size: computed as the acarbose bounding box plus a 8.0 A margin per axis, rounded up to 0.5 A
tight_auto.rationale: WITHDRAWN AS A TEST OF AN OVERSIZED BOX. The earlier rationale here said a 28 A cube is a very large search volume for an 86-heavy-atom macrocycle. Measured on the repository's own poses that is wrong: 28 A is close to the smallest cube that holds these ligands at all. A box built from acarbose's axis-aligned bounding box plus 8 A gives edges near 14 A on the short axis measured here, and all 972 committed conformers exceed 14 A, so the tight arm would refuse every run rather than search a smaller volume. Tier 3 is the arm that uses it. See PROTOCOL.md defect 4 for the arithmetic and the open decision.
tight_auto.not_rotation_invariant: An axis-aligned bounding box depends on the arbitrary orientation of the crystal frame. The rotation-invariant size of a ligand is its diameter, the largest distance between two heavy atoms, and that is what the per-run fit check uses.

docking.box_centre_rule: Primary centre is the centroid of the heavy atoms of the bound acarbose in chain A. The centroid of the catalytic triad carboxylate oxygens (Asp451, Glu489, Asp562) is computed as a cross-check and the distance between the two centres is recorded. If they differ by more than 4.0 A the run stops, because that would mean the site has been identified wrongly.
docking.observed_ligand_diameter_source: largest heavy-atom diameter over all 972 committed single-model poses in data/poses, hydrogens and Meeko G pseudo-atoms excluded and the CG closure carbons kept. The maximum is 27.31 A, in scrambled_39_CHPHPWRWC_1smd_split_3, an 86-heavy-atom null member; the median is 22.37 A. Recomputed from those files by a test, so it cannot go stale. It is a lower bound on what a newly built conformer may be.

ligand_preparation.builder: biophysics_engine.build_macrocycle_3d, imported unchanged from the repository root
ligand_preparation.why_imported_rather_than_reimplemented: The comparison with the existing 3AIC numbers is only meaningful if the ligands are built by exactly the same code path.
ligand_preparation.conformer_seed_note: The existing pipeline builds one conformer per sequence with ETKDGv3 at seed 42. Meeko then opens the disulfide macrocycle at one bond, confirmed by the CG0/G0 glue pseudo-atom pair present in 1183 of the 1244 committed pose files, every cyclic nine-mer among them, so Vina does sample the torsions that opening exposes. An earlier revision of this file said the opposite, on the strength of a detector that read the atom type with a two-column slice and so truncated CG0 to CG. What remains true is narrower: bond lengths, bond angles and the ring-closure geometry are fixed by that single embedding and Vina varies none of them, so every published score still rests on one starting conformer per molecule. Seed 42 is kept as the primary for comparability with the existing numbers, and the other four are run on a subset to measure how much of the lead-versus-null difference is embedding luck.

ring_sampling_evidence.the_61_are: acarbose and the linear and eleven-residue ligands, none of which has a macrocycle to open
ring_sampling_evidence.detector: retarget_gtfb/run_docking.py has_glue_atoms, which reads the AutoDock type as the last whitespace-separated token on the ATOM line

off_target_receptors.1SMD: human salivary alpha-amylase, reused from demo_data/receptors as already prepared
off_target_receptors.1LZ1: human lysozyme, reused from demo_data/receptors as already prepared
off_target_receptors.note: These two are reused unchanged. Only the on-target receptor changes in this package.

tiers.1: Primary. Wide box, 5 docking seeds, conformer seed 42: the four named contenders plus acarbose redocking calibration.
tiers.2: Null distributions. Wide box, 3 docking seeds, conformer seed 42: null A (39 wild-type permutations, the existing set) and null B (39 reference-scaffold permutations, newly generated because the existing set is not composition-matched to the reference scaffold).
tiers.3: Box-size test. Tight box, 3 docking seeds: the four contenders, acarbose, and the first 12 members of each null set.
tiers.4: Conformer-ensemble test. Wide box, docking seed 1, conformer seeds 101 to 404: reference scaffold, wild type, and the first 10 members of each null set.
tiers.5: Off-target counter-screens on 1SMD and 1LZ1. Wide box, 3 docking seeds: the four contenders.
